notes.title: Major Update #1
notes.content:
[h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42858083/b25e01250877f76f28b7eef0f3239f930318608a.jpg"][/img][/h3][p][/p][h3][b][i][u]SYSTEM / FEATURES[/u][/i][/b][/h3][p][b]ADDED:[/b] FSR (AMD FidelityFX Super Resolution) has been added to the settings. (Default: Enable)[/p][p][b]FIXED:[/b] White glare issue caused by Global Illumination Quality settings.[b]
[/b][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b][i][u]GRAPHICS / ART[/u][/i][/b][/h3][p][b]FIXED:[/b] Issue related to Volumetric Fog.[/p][p][b]FIXED:[/b] Lights are taking too long to activate in certain areas.[/p][p][b]FIXED:[/b] Faruk Bey is getting stuck in specific environmental spots.[/p][p][b]FIXED:[/b] Foliage (vegetation) issues in certain cinematic sequences.[/p][p][b]FIXED:[/b] Collision problems in the cave section.[/p][p][b]IMPROVED:[/b] GPU and CPU performance.[/p][p][b]IMPROVED:[/b] NPC face textures.[/p][p][b]IMPROVED:[/b] Local volumetric fog.[/p][p][b]IMPROVED:[/b] Lighting and visual quality in certain cinematic sequences.[/p][p][b]IMPROVED:[/b] Lighting and optimization in the Dream Sequence.[/p][p][b]IMPROVED:[/b] Outfit and face models for Börü Alp and Serdar Alp.[/p][p][b]IMPROVED:[/b] NPCs that previously had movement/stuck issues.[/p][p][b]IMPROVED:[/b] Variety in NPC faces and textures.[/p][p][b]ADDED:[/b] Training NPCs in the Training Ground.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b][i][u]GAMEPLAY / PROGRAMMING[/u][/i][/b][/h3][p][b]FIXED:[/b] Critical bug related to throwable barrels.[/p][p][b]FIXED:[/b] Enemies spawning underground in some situations.[/p][p][b]FIXED:[/b] Critical issue related to entering the Shaman Boss area.[/p][p][b]FIXED:[/b] Critical bug causing Nightmares to spawn in unreachable locations in the Dream Level.[/p][p][b]FIXED:[/b] A Cinematics in the Dream Level not triggering and breaking the game.[/p][p][b]FIXED:[/b] VFX issues caused by Debuff Effects in some cinematics.[/p][p][b]FIXED:[/b] Walking issue encountered during the Horse Care mission.[/p][p][b]FIXED:[/b] Bug related to posture-break finisher not working properly.[/p][p][b]FIXED:[/b] Audio cut-off for Faruk Bey in the Training mission.[/p][p][b]FIXED:[/b] Ability to cancel attacks repeatedly in the Training mission.[/p][p][b]FIXED:[/b] Minor bug related to quick weapon equip.[/p][p][b]BALANCED:[/b] Combat mechanics for the Miroxar Boss.[/p][p][b]BALANCED:[/b] Damage value of one of Turgut’s Skills.[/p][p][b]BALANCED:[/b] Damage values related to the Snake’s Debuff Effect.[/p][p][b]IMPROVED:[/b] Animations and sound effects for the Miroxar Boss.[/p][p][b]IMPROVED:[/b] Dodge behavior after Kick, Block, and Parry.[/p][p][b]IMPROVED:[/b] Enemy AI combat behaviors.[/p][p][b]ADDED:[/b] When using Horse Summon, weapons will no longer be auto-equipped.[/p][p][b]ADDED:[/b] Inverse Kinematics (IK) system for Horse, Wolf, and Deer legs.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][u][i][b]AUDIO / LOCALIZATION[/b][/i][/u][/h3][p][b]FIXED:[/b] Audio issues in some cinematic scenes.[/p][p][b]FIXED:[/b] Several translation issues in Arabic.[/p][p][b]IMPROVED:[/b] Crying woman sound effects.[/p][p][b]IMPROVED:[/b] Ambient sounds of some NPCs in the tribe.[/p][p][b]IMPROVED:[/b] Volume levels of jackal death and growling sounds.[/p][p][b]IMPROVED:[/b] Sound effect for when enemies detect the player.[/p][p][b]IMPROVED:[/b] Waterfall sound dynamics.[/p][p][b]IMPROVED:[/b] Sound dynamics of certain NPCs.[/p][p][b]IMPROVED:[/b] Subtitles for some in-game dialogue.[/p][p][b]ADDED:[/b] Drum sounds at the entrance of the tribe.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][u][i][b]UI / UX[/b][/i][/u][/h3][p][b]ADDED:[/b] Resolution Scaling option in Settings > Graphics.[/p][p][b]ADDED:[/b] Upscale Frame Generation option in Settings > Graphics.[/p][p][b]ADDED:[/b] Weapon swap button customization in the "Settings" menu.[/p][p][b]ADDED:[/b] Social media access buttons added to the main menu.[/p][p][b]ADDED:[/b] Widescreen (32:9) background support for the main menu.[/p][p][b]IMPROVED:[/b] Font size increased in the horse menu.

notes.title: First Day Bug Fix [V.0.80.239.544]
notes.content:
[h1][b]Ertugrul of Ulukayin - V.0.80.239.544[/b][/h1][p][i][u]First Day Bug Fix[/u][/i][/p][p][i][u]DEVELOPER NOTES[/u][/i][/p][p]
[u][b]PROGRAMMING[/b][/u][/p][list][*][p]FIXED: Bug where the horse could be summoned right after Turgut and Meryem exited the cave.[/p][/*][*][p]FIXED: Issue where the player would start in the sky after the jackal fight cinematic.[/p][/*][*][p]FIXED: Game-breaking bug allowing players to enter through the backdoor during the Shaman confrontation.[/p][/*][*][p]FIXED: Flickering and visibility issues with Ertuğrul during the Shaman death cinematic.[/p][/*][*][p]FIXED: Dream sequence bug where early nightmares spawned in unreachable areas and broke the game.[/p][/*][*][p]FIXED: Final nightmare cinematic not triggering after defeating the last enemy in Ertuğrul’s dream.[/p][/*][*][p]FIXED: Poor performance for players who previously played the demo or an older Epic Games version.[/p][/*][*][p]FIXED: Underground spawning issue with NPCs during the mission to confront the Shaman.[/p][/*][*][p]FIXED: Exploit where players could spam the bow using left-click.[/p][/*][*][p]FIXED: Game-breaking bug allowing Meryem to leave the Armenian village before completing the required objectives.[/p][/*][*][p]FIXED: Game-breaking bug when trying to grab barrels using right-click.[/p][/*][*][p]FIXED: Bug causing companion NPCs to teleport suddenly when looked at.[/p][/*][*][p]FIXED: Friendly characters dying unexpectedly during the Mongol raid near the Weavery.[/p][/*][*][p]IMPROVED: Added visual feedback (VFX) when poisoned by a snake bite.[/p][/*][*][p]IMPROVED: Added a marker in the deer hunting mission to prevent the deer from becoming unfindable in the final stages.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[u][b]LEVEL DESIGN[/b][/u][/p][list][*][p]FIXED: Increased water availability and accessibility in the antidote crafting area during the snake encounter mission.[/p][/*][*][p]FIXED: Dagger floating mid-air when thrown in specific cave areas during Turgut’s encounter with cannibals.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[u][b]AUDIO/SUBTITLES[/b][/u][/p][list][*][p]FIXED: Missing voice lines for certain NPCs in the tribe.[/p][/*][*][p]IMPROVED: Various foley, dialogue, and subtitle polish.[/p][/*][*][p]FIXED: Missing subtitles during the final cinematic.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[u][b]UI/UX[/b][/u][/p][list][*][p]FIXED: Game-breaking issue where buttons in the initial disclaimer screen did not respond.[/p][/*][*][p]IMPROVED: Added reminders for Turgut’s "Skills" and "Attributes" when starting the game with him.
